dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The posterior margin exhibits a gentle concave curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius, morphologically classified as rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of the fin's base width to its maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth parabolic curve with a moderate radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt pixel projection with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters on the mid-lateral flank and a distinct notch on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-colored luminance and digital aliasing on silhouette boundaries.
